messages:
mita: hey all, first day question: i can view infra dashboards but not edit, and Sentry shows 'Project not found' for our service. who should i contact to get edit + project access?

elena: welcome @mita! i handle Sentry invites. DM me the email you used to sign in (SSO preferred) and the exact project name/slug.

devex-bot: To request Grafana edit rights use https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests -> select 'Grafana Editor' -> add your team tag (eng-infra) and include the folder name 'platform-dashboards'. If this is urgent for production alerts, react with :rocket: or add 'prod-impact' to the request. Typical approval 1-2 biz days.

eng-oncall: @mita if this is generating noisy alerts include 'prod-impact' and CC @eng-oncall. we can mute noisy rules temporarily. once you have edit rights paste the dashboard link and we'll do a quick review.

mita: thanks! DM'ed @elena with mita@redwood.dev and submitted Grafana request (added prod-impact). will post links when i can edit.
